title: 第6章：团队磨合，前路规划
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

紫色标记在地图上一跳一跳，每隔三秒刷新一次位置。

朝他的方向，移动速度不快，但稳定，没有停顿。

林昊盯着那个标记看了五秒，划掉面板。

不管它是什么，二十二公里的距离，现在追不上他，先处理眼前的事。

车厢里六个人大眼瞪小眼，苏晴的女儿醒了，揪着妈妈衣领不撒手，眼睛红肿，嘴唇起了干皮。

陈明搂着李小雨缩在储物柜边上，两个人占了半条过道。

赵铁柱还杵在车尾门旁边，防暴叉戳在脚边。

王德发抱着他的箱子，谁都不看。

六个人挤在八个立方米的铁壳子里，感觉连空气都是馊的。

林昊发动引擎，沿高速往前开了三公里，找到一座高架桥。

桥墩是那种倒T形结构，两根水泥柱子撑起上方的匝道，底下形成一个天然凹槽。

三面有遮挡，左边是护坡，右边是隔音墙的残段，后面是桥墩本体。

只有正前方敞着，对着高速辅道。

一个方向。

守一个方向就够了。

车停进桥墩阴影里，熄火。

“下来。”

林昊拉开侧门，从驾驶座后面翻出那箱压缩饼干，撕了两包扔在引擎盖上。

“吃点东西，开个会。”

赵铁柱第一个跳下来，落地没声，脚掌先着地的习惯。

他扫了一圈周围地形，没说话，走到正前方敞口的位置站定。

大家自动补位。

苏晴抱着孩子下来，女儿死活不肯松手，她只好单手撕开压缩饼干，掰碎了往孩子嘴里塞。

陈明扶着李小雨最后出来。

李小雨左脚绑着绷带，踩地就龇牙。

王德发抱着箱子坐在车门台阶上，没挪窝。

“说正事。”

林昊靠在车头，掰着指头算，“食物够吃两个星期，省着点的话。

水够十天。油还能跑四百公里左右。”

没人接腔。

“知道什么意思吗？四百公里跑完，这车就是个铁壳子，推都推不动。

十天之后没有新的水源，渴死。两周之后没有新的食物——”

“去省城。”王德发开口了。

林昊没理他。

“我在省城有关系，”王德发把箱子往怀里搂了搂，“市里肯定有安全区。

政府不可能不管的，军队、武警、国民警卫——反正肯定有人在维持秩序。

我认识人，能进去。”

赵铁柱回了一下头。

就一下。

“省城多远？”

“三百多公里，”王德发说得飞快，早就查过了，“四百公里续航绰绰有余”。

“三百多公里，省会城市，常住人口八百万。”

赵铁柱没回头，盯着前方辅道的方向，“感染率就算百分之一，八万只丧尸。

百分之十，八十万只。你拿什么进去？拿你箱子里那堆黄铜？”

王德发的脸抽了一下，“那是纯黄金”。

“我不在乎，”赵铁柱说。

苏晴一直没吭声。

她把女儿换到另一条胳膊上，嗓子哑得厉害。

“我无所谓去哪，有个地方能让妞妞睡一觉就行，安全的地方，哪儿都行。”

妞妞，那个三岁的小女孩。

眼睛哭肿了，嘴里嚼着压缩饼干碎渣，没有出声。

林昊划开系统面板。

其他人看不见面板，但他的动作停顿了两秒，手指凭空点了几下，划了几下。赵铁柱瞥了一眼，没有多余反应。

大地图铺开。

三个标记点。

前方八十公里，黄色菱形——【物资据点·建材仓库】，物资信号中等，危险等级低至中。

一百五十公里，红色圆点——【中型城镇】，物资丰富，危险等级高。

三百公里，一个灰色的问号，【？】。

性质未知，信号微弱，无法解析。

八十公里那个建材仓库最扎眼。

精钢板。

LV2升级差两块精钢板和两块能源模块碎片。

建材仓库有精钢板！

升到LV2，房车承载力提升，净水系统上线，太阳能充电板上线。

不用再担心水耗尽，不用再担心系统断电。

六条命加一个孩子的重量压在LV1的底盘上，悬挂已经快塌了。

不升级，这车跑不了多远。

“八十公里外有个建材仓库。”林昊收了面板，“

我要去那儿拿东西。

拿到了，车能改装，跑得更远、装得更多、更结实。

Page (1/3)

The purple marker jumps around the map, refreshing its position every three seconds.

In his direction, the movement was slow but steady, without pause.

Lin Hao stared at the mark for five seconds and crossed out the panel.

No matter what it is, it's twenty-two kilometers away. If you can't catch up with him now, deal with the matter at hand first.

The six people in the carriage stared at each other. Su Qing's daughter woke up and held on to her mother's collar. Her eyes were red and swollen, and her lips were dry.

Chen Ming hugged Li Xiaoyu and huddled beside the locker, and the two of them occupied half of the aisle.

Zhao Tiezhu was still standing next to the tailgate of the car, with the anti-riot fork at his feet.

Wang Defa hugged his box without looking at anyone.

Six people were squeezed into an eight-cubic-meter iron shell, and even the air felt rancid.

Lin Hao started the engine and drove three kilometers along the highway until he found a viaduct.

The bridge pier is an inverted T-shaped structure, with two cement pillars supporting the ramp above and forming a natural groove below.

There are shields on three sides: the left side is the slope protection, the right side is the fragment of the sound insulation wall, and behind it is the bridge pier itself.

Only the front is open, facing the expressway.

One direction.

It is enough to stick to one direction.

The car stopped in the shadow of the bridge pier and turned off.

"Come down."

Lin Hao opened the side door, dug out the box of compressed biscuits from behind the driver's seat, tore two packages and threw them on the hood.

"Eat something and have a meeting."

Zhao Tiezhu was the first to jump down. He landed silently and had the habit of landing on the soles of his feet first.

He scanned the surrounding terrain, said nothing, and walked to the open position directly in front of him to stand.

Everyone automatically fills in.

Su Qing came down with the child in her arms, but her daughter refused to let go. She had to tear open the compressed biscuits with one hand, break them into pieces and stuff them into the child's mouth.

Chen Ming helped Li Xiaoyu come out last.

Li Xiaoyu's left foot was bandaged, and he bared his teeth when he stepped on the ground.

Wang Defa sat on the steps of the car door holding the box and did not move.

"Let's get down to business."

Lin Hao leaned on the front of the car and counted on his fingers, "The food is enough for two weeks, if you save a little.

Enough water for ten days.The oil can still run about 400 kilometers."

No one answered.

"Do you know what it means? After running four hundred kilometers, this car is just an iron shell and cannot be pushed.

After ten days without any new water source, he died of thirst.No new food after two weeks—"

"Go to the provincial capital." Wang Defa said.

Lin Hao ignored him.

"I have connections in the provincial capital," Wang Defa hugged the box in his arms, "There must be a safe zone in the city.

The government cannot ignore it. The army, armed police, and national guard—someone must be maintaining order anyway.

I know people and can get in."

Zhao Tiezhu turned his head.

Just for a moment.

"How far is the provincial capital?"

"More than three hundred kilometers," Wang Defa said quickly, having already checked it, "four hundred kilometers is more than enough."

"More than three hundred kilometers away, it's a provincial capital city with a permanent population of eight million."

Zhao Tiezhu did not look back and stared in the direction of the auxiliary road ahead, "Even if the infection rate is 1%, there are 80,000 zombies.

Ten percent, 800,000.What do you bring in?Get that pile of brass in your box?"

Wang Defa's face twitched, "That's pure gold."

"I don't care," Zhao Tiezhu said.

Su Qing remained silent.

She moved her daughter to her other arm, her voice hoarse.

"I don't care where I go, as long as there is a place where Niu Niu can sleep, a safe place, anywhere will do."

Niuniu, that three-year-old little girl.

Her eyes were swollen from crying, and she chewed compressed biscuit crumbs in her mouth without making a sound.

Lin Hao opened the system panel.

Others couldn't see the panel, but his movements paused for two seconds, and he clicked and scratched a few times out of thin air.Zhao Tiezhu glanced at it without any unnecessary reaction.

The big map is spread out.

Three marking points.

Eighty kilometers ahead, there is a yellow diamond - [Material Stronghold·Building Materials Warehouse], the material signal is medium, and the danger level is low to medium.

One hundred and fifty kilometers, red dot - [medium-sized town], rich in supplies and high danger level.

Three hundred kilometers, a gray question mark, [?】.

The nature is unknown, the signal is weak and cannot be analyzed.

The building materials warehouse eighty kilometers away is the most eye-catching.

Fine steel plate.

The LV2 upgrade requires two fine steel plates and two energy module fragments.

The building materials warehouse has fine steel plates!

Upgrading to LV2, the carrying capacity of the RV is increased, the water purification system is online, and the solar charging board is online.

No more worries about running out of water or system outages.

The weight of six lives and one child was pressing down on the chassis of LV1, and the suspension was about to collapse.

Without upgrades, this car won't go far.

"There is a building materials warehouse eighty kilometers away." Lin Hao collected the panel, "

I'm going to get something there.

Once you get it, the car can be modified to run further, have more equipment, and be stronger.
